shadows.name: dock
shadows.purpose: Separate the retractable controls from the page edge.

motion.name: ambient-drift
motion.purpose: Move pale ambient light behind the page.

motion.name: bubble-reveal
motion.purpose: Slide quick navigation from the right edge.

motion.name: answer-reveal
motion.purpose: Open and close the current answer.

components.name: Hero Primary Action
components.description: Solid white pill that enters the hymn.
components.css: .ds-hero-primary { min-height:50px; padding:0 20px; border:1px solid white; border-radius:50px; background:white; color:#04699e; font:700 13px "DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s,transform .28s; } .ds-hero-primary:hover { background:#e4fbff; transform:translateY(-4px); } .ds-hero-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #08a4dd; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Hero Secondary Action
components.description: Translucent companion action on the blue cover.
components.css: .ds-hero-secondary { min-height:50px; padding:0 20px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45); border-radius:50px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.15); color:white; backdrop-filter:blur(9px); font:700 13px "DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s,transform .28s; } .ds-hero-secondary:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.29); transform:translateY(-4px); } .ds-hero-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #08a4dd; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Dock Destination
components.description: Circular contextual destination with a blue active state.
components.css: .ds-side-link { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:38px; padding:7px 10px 7px 25px; border:0; border-radius:11px; background:transparent; color:#174b66; font:700 13px "DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-side-number { width:26px; color:#087db9; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; } .ds-side-link:hover,.ds-current { background:#e5f6fc; color:#006cae; } .ds-side-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #08a4dd; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Dock Search
components.description: Retractable search field extending left from the top dock control.
components.css: .ds-side-search { display:flex; align-items:center; padding:10px; border:1px solid #b7dce9; border-radius:11px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.8); } .ds-side-search:focus-within { border-color:#087dca; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #b9eafb; } .ds-side-search input { width:100%; min-width:0; border:0; outline:0; background:transparent; color:#092f43; font:12px "DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-side-search input::placeholder { color:#6e9bae; }

components.name: Study Tab
components.description: Mode switch with blue line and count chip.
components.css: .ds-study-tab { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:0 1px 19px; border:0; background:none; color:#5c8498; font:700 15px "DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-study-tab span { padding:3px 6px; border-radius:5px; background:#e2f4fb; color:#0875ad; font-size:11px; } .ds-study-tab:hover,.ds-selected { color:#006fae; } .ds-selected:after { content:""; position:absolute; bottom:-1px; left:0; right:0; height:3px; border-radius:4px; background:#078ed3; } .ds-study-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #08a4dd; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Study Tool
components.description: Circular control for focus or reading tools.
components.html: <button class="ds-study-tool" aria-label="Modo enfoque"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 12s3.5-6 10-6 10 6 10 6-3.5 6-10 6S2 12 2 12Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-study-tool { display:grid; place-items:center; width:48px; height:48px; border:1px solid #b8dbe9; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(255,255,255,.7); color:#07486f; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .25s,background .25s; } .ds-study-tool:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); background:#dff7ff; } .ds-study-tool:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #08a4dd; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Question Card
components.description: The active scrolling question with expanded answer.
components.html:
01
EL HIMNO¿Qué representa la bandera?

components.css: .ds-question { display:flex; gap:22px; padding:27px 29px; border:1px solid #43a7d1; border-radius:19px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.91); color:#092f43; box-shadow:0 26px 50px -42px #09648c; } .ds-question-number { color:#087fbb; font:35px/.95 "Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif; } .ds-question div { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px; } .ds-question small { color:#067bb5; font:800 11px "DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.15em; } .ds-question strong { font:500 20px/1.5 Literata,Georgia,serif; } .ds-question p { margin:8px 0 0; font:18px/1.85 "DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif; }

components.name: Explanation Panel
components.description: Complete stanza explanation with translucent white surface.
components.html:
¿Qué explica esta estrofa?

La explicación completa se lee aquí.
components.css: .ds-explanation { padding:34px 42px 46px; border:1px solid #b8dce9; border-radius:22px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.81); color:#143d50; box-shadow:0 25px 60px -53px #145d7e; backdrop-filter:blur(14px); } .ds-explanation h3 { margin:0 0 20px; font:400 57px/1 "Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif; } .ds-explanation p { margin:0; font:19px/1.85 "DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif; }

components.name: Navigation Bubble
components.description: Auto-hiding right-edge shortcut with active blue item.
components.html: <nav class="ds-bubble"><button class="ds-bubble-item ds-bubble-active" aria-label="Coro">C</button><button class="ds-bubble-item" aria-label="Primera estrofa">1</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-bubble { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; width:max-content; padding:11px 9px; border:1px solid rgba(23,127,166,.23); border-radius:36px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.88); box-shadow:0 16px 50px -32px #075477; backdrop-filter:blur(20px); } .ds-bubble-item { width:39px; height:39px; border:1px solid #b2d8e6; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(238,249,255,.9); color:#136f9e; font:800 12px "DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .25s,background .25s; } .ds-bubble-item:hover { transform:scale(1.17); } .ds-bubble-active { border-color:#007fbd; background:#058aca; color:white; box-shadow:0 7px 13px -7px #07689c; } .ds-bubble-item:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #08a4dd; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: The interface presents a luminous blue cover before the study material. An oversized Instrument Serif wordmark sits over moving blue light and ribbon layers, with white pill actions into the hymn and questionnaire. Behind the study area, a pale cyan ambient field keeps the page airy. Once studying, the content returns to a measured editorial pace. A centered 990 px study section, serif folio titles, numbered verses, complete explanations, and a focused question list guide attention. A single retractable dock keeps navigation available without reducing the reading width.
keyCharacteristics: Saturated blue gradient hero with soft moving light, ribbons, and oversized serif lettering.
Instrument Serif display type, Literata study text, and DM Sans controls and explanations.
Auto-hiding right dock with mode icons, contextual index, search, and saved markers.
White translucent cards, fine cyan borders, and active question focus.

rules.name: The Blue Field Rule
rules.body: Blue gradients and diffuse light are native to the cover; the study area uses pale cyan, translucent white, and fine blue strokes.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Coral, gold, and green enter through reader annotations; they do not replace blue navigation states.

rules.name: The Three Voice Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif names the experience, Literata carries prompts and verse, and DM Sans carries explanation and interface language.

rules.name: The Retractable Dock Rule
rules.body: Keep all navigation in one right-edge dock; expose only its handle at rest and reveal search, modes, contextual destinations, and markers together.

rules.name: The Focused Card Rule
rules.body: Resting questions fade and blur; the active or keyboard-focused question becomes fully legible and elevated.

dos: Do use the blue cover's gradients and moving light when extending the brand-facing first view.
Do retain the expressive display, literary reading, and direct interface type roles.
Do keep the dock reachable by touch and keyboard, with visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn reader marker colors into persistent navigation accents.
Don't elevate every question card; only the active or focused card gets the stronger white and shadow treatment.
Don't replace the complete answer and explanation text with short summaries.
